description: A shell script that tests the behavior of 'skip-worktree' bits in a Git repository, including setup, status checks, updating the index, and the effects on file state and Git commands.

methods.name: setup_absent
methods.description: Removes the file '1', adds it to the index, and marks it with the skip-worktree bit.

methods.name: test_absent
methods.description: Checks that file '1' is absent in the index and filesystem.

methods.name: setup_dirty
methods.description: Marks the file '1' as modified (dirty) and sets the skip-worktree bit.

methods.name: test_dirty
methods.description: Checks that file '1' remains in the index with the expected stage and content, and verifies its modified content.
